_recon_note: BUNDLED DEFAULT, compiled into the recon binary. This is the pass-1 alkylation-agnostic open search. It carries NO database.fasta and NO mzml_paths on purpose: both are always supplied at runtime from --fasta and the mzML argument, and Sage's -f flag and positional mzML beat the JSON anyway. A path here would be a ghost. The record of what actually ran is the effective-params.json written beside each search, and Sage's own results.json beside that. Every other field must match testing/configs/open-search-params.json — bundled_default_matches_committed_template asserts it.
